hero_subtitle: Adoptier Lieber connects shelters with animal lovers. Discover animals near you, swipe through profiles and find your new best friend – straight from the shelter.
showcase_title: Who is looking for a home?
showcase_subtitle: A little preview of the animals you can discover on Adoptier Lieber. Try it out: swipe right if an animal wins your heart.
showcase_keyboard_hint: Keyboard: left arrow to skip, right arrow to like.
showcase_empty_text: Those were our placeholder animals. Soon you'll find real animals from shelters near you here.
animal_2_tagline: Playful family dog, enjoys long walks.
animal_3_tagline: Curious rabbit looking for a buddy.
animal_4_tagline: Lively guinea pig, whistles for cucumber.
animal_5_tagline: Chatty parrot with plenty of character.
animal_6_tagline: Calm cat who enjoys her independence.
animal_7_tagline: Eager-to-learn dog who knows the basic commands.
reviews_subtitle: Three of many stories that began with a swipe.
reviews_1_text: We found our tomcat Findus through Adoptier Lieber. Getting in touch with the shelter was easy and the profiles are made with love.
reviews_2_text: As a shelter, the platform saves us an enormous amount of time. The enquiries are sincere and well pre-filtered.
reviews_3_text: Swiping is addictive – in the best possible way. Two weeks later, Balu moved in with us.
